# Study Time Statistics 1.3.1

## English

This hotfix responds to community feedback about unnecessary background analytics work in 1.2.0 and 1.3.0.

### Changed

- Removed the 15-second full-history analytics refresh that ran for inline note statistics while the full statistics panel was closed.
- Extended analytics now load lazily when needed and reuse a revision-aware cache when study data has not changed.
- While the Study Analytics view is open, relevant data changes trigger a short debounced refresh.
- Added a **Refresh now** action for an explicit reload and recalculation.
- A full analytics pass now reads one consistent local data snapshot instead of repeatedly reloading storage for every recorded date.
- Automatic reading-time tracking remains independent and continues normally.

### Verification

- Production build, TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint, automated tests, dependency audit, and whitespace checks pass.
- The plugin remains local-first and makes no network requests for analytics.

## 中文

这个热修复回应了社区对 1.2.0 和 1.3.0 后台统计性能的反馈。

### 变更

- 删除了完整统计面板关闭时，笔记顶部统计仍每 15 秒执行一次的全历史分析。
- 扩展统计改为按需加载；学习数据没有变化时会复用带版本标记的缓存。
- “学习分析”页面打开期间，相关数据变化会经过短暂防抖后刷新。
- 新增“**立即刷新**”操作，可以主动重新读取并计算统计数据。
- 每次完整分析现在只读取一个一致的本地数据快照，不再为每个历史日期重复读取存储。
- 自动阅读计时完全独立，继续正常运行。

### 验证

- 生产构建、TypeScript、ESLint、Stylelint、自动化测试、依赖安全审计和空白检查全部通过。
- 插件继续坚持本地优先，统计过程不会发送网络请求。
